label: EVASION — the dispatch goes out FIRST, then an ls results/ runs after; ordering must be enforced (ls before dispatch)
why: An `ls results/` that runs AFTER the dispatch does not retroactively make the dispatch safe — by then the duplicate research is already in flight. The ls-of-siblings probe must PRECEDE the dispatch, so a trailing ls still FIRES.
